```{r}
library(tidyverse)
# loading in data
sal <- read_csv(paste0(
  "https://stat.cmu.edu/~sgallagh/courses/mads-fall-2026/",
  "datavis-36613/data/salaries.csv.gz"
))
```

```{r}
nrow(sal)
sum(duplicated(sal))
sal |>
  filter(duplicated(sal) | duplicated(sal, fromLast = TRUE))
sal |>
  count(work_year)
ggplot(sal, aes(x = factor(work_year))) +
  geom_bar() +
  labs(
    x = "Report year",
    y = "Number of salary records",
    title = "Salary records by report year"
  ) + theme_classic()
str(sal)
summary(sal)
colSums(is.na(sal))
sum(duplicated(sal))
table(sal$employment_type)
table(sal$experience_level)
table(sal$company_size)
```


```{r}
table(sal$employment_type)
table(sal$experience_level)
table(sal$company_size)
```


```{r}
# cleaning as needed
sal$experience_level <- factor(
  sal$experience_level,
  levels = c("EX", "SE", "MI", "EN"),
  labels = c("Executive", "Senior", "Mid", "Entry")
)
```
